newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, HRW wheat up, soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, HRW wheat up, soy steady.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB corn and hard red winter wheat basis values were mostly steady to higher while soybeans were flat, export sources said.
"Nobody wants to sell anything until they see some farmer selling," a wheat dealer said. "The market has a holiday mood type of atmosphere. It is really quiet."
CBOT wheat closed higher on optimism for sales of U.S. wheat this week to several countries, including Turkey, Algeria and Pakistan.
